data.name: CancelLaunch
data.comment: Button on the workspace launch-status window. Cancels the entire workspace launch, unlike "Skip this app" in an elevation warning, which skips only one app.

data.name: Dismiss
data.comment: Button that closes the workspace launch-status window. Distinct from "Cancel launch", which sends a workspace-wide cancellation.

data.name: LauncherWindowTitle
data.value: Ihr Arbeitsbereich wird gestartet. Warten auf ...
data.comment: Title of the launch-status window while apps in a saved PowerToys Workspaces layout are launching or being positioned.

data.name: LaunchStateWaiting
data.comment: Tooltip and screen reader label for an app that has not launched yet. This can include waiting for the user's elevation decision.

data.name: LaunchStateLaunched
data.comment: Tooltip and screen reader label for an app that has launched but whose window has not yet been positioned.

data.name: LaunchStateLaunchedAndMoved
data.comment: Tooltip and screen reader label for a successfully launched app whose window has been moved into its workspace position.

data.name: LaunchStateFailed
data.comment: Tooltip and screen reader label for a launch or positioning failure, including infrastructure errors. This is not a deliberate per-app skip or cancellation of the entire workspace.

data.name: LaunchStateCanceled
data.comment: Tooltip and screen reader label for a canceled app launch, such as canceling the workspace or declining Windows User Account Control. Distinct from "Skipped", which is the deliberate per-app choice in the PowerToys signature warning.

data.name: LaunchStateSkipped
data.comment: Visible status and screen reader label for one app skipped by the user's elevation-warning decision, including Escape or closing that warning. Other apps continue launching. This is neither a launch failure nor cancellation of the entire workspace.

data.name: SignatureWarningTitle
data.comment: Title of a per-app elevation consent warning. This is not the Windows User Account Control prompt.

data.name: SignatureWarningExplanation
data.value: PowerToys konnte die digitale Signatur dieser App nicht überprüfen. Wenn Sie es als Administrator ausführen, kann es Ihr System ändern. Möchten Sie den Vorgang fortsetzen?
data.comment: Warning before an elevated app launch when verification is inconclusive or fails. Do not imply that a signature proves an app safe or that verification failure proves it malicious.

data.name: SignatureWarningTrustLimits
data.value: Signaturprüfungen verwenden die Windows-Vertrauenseinstellungen dieses Computers und zwischengespeicherte Zertifikatinformationen. Sie garantieren nicht, dass eine App oder ihre Befehlszeilenargumente sicher sind. Ihre Auswahl gilt nur für diesen Start. Windows fordert möglicherweise weiterhin Administratorberechtigungen an.
data.comment: Explain the limits of machine-local trust and cached-only certificate checks: no online revocation lookup is promised, and local trust or a successful signature check is not a safety guarantee. Arguments are not verified. Consent is one-time only, not permanent trust or a bypass of Windows User Account Control.

data.name: SignatureWarningApp
data.comment: Label for the application display name in a per-app elevation warning. The displayed name itself is provided by the app or workspace and is not translated.

data.name: SignatureWarningEscapedDisplay
data.value: Formatierungs- und Steuerzeichen werden als Escape-Sequenzen angezeigt. Beim Kopieren der Details bleibt der Originaltext erhalten.
data.comment: Shown only when application-provided names, paths, arguments, or status contain control characters, line separators, or Unicode bidirectional formatting controls. These characters are displayed visibly, for example as \n or \u202E, to prevent misleading lines or reordered text. The original values used for launching and copying are unchanged.

data.name: SignatureWarningPath
data.comment: Label for the executable file path. The value is not translated and is displayed left to right, with misleading control characters escaped. Launching and copying preserve the original target.

data.name: SignatureWarningReason
data.comment: Heading for the explanation of why signature verification did not succeed.

data.name: SignatureWarningDetails
data.comment: Expandable section containing the command-line arguments and the Windows verification status code.

data.name: SignatureWarningCopyDetails
data.comment: Button inside the warning's Details section. Copies the displayed app name, location, verification reason, command-line arguments, and Windows status to the clipboard. It does not approve or launch the app.

data.name: SignatureWarningCopyDetailsError
data.value: Die Details konnten nicht in die Zwischenablage kopiert werden. Versuchen Sie es noch einmal.
data.comment: Error when the Copy details action cannot access the Windows clipboard, for example because another app is using it. The launch decision is unchanged.

data.name: SignatureWarningArguments
data.comment: Label for the arguments that will be passed to the app. The value is not translated or verified and is displayed left to right, with control characters escaped. Launching and copying preserve the original arguments.

data.name: SignatureWarningStatus
data.comment: Label for a Windows HRESULT such as 0x800B0100, not a localized success/failure description. The hexadecimal code is displayed unchanged and left to right.

data.name: SignatureWarningSkip
data.comment: Default, initially focused button. Enter, Escape, or closing the warning skips only the current app and allows the rest of the workspace launch to continue. Do not translate as canceling the entire workspace.

data.name: SignatureWarningSkipHelp
data.value: Starten Sie diese App nicht. Starten Sie die anderen Apps in diesem Arbeitsbereich weiter.
data.comment: Screen reader help for "Skip this app". Distinguish this per-app choice from "Cancel launch", which cancels all remaining workspace apps.

data.name: SignatureWarningRunAnyway
data.comment: Alternate, non-default action allowing this one app launch to proceed with elevation. Does not establish permanent trust or bypass Windows UAC or execution policy.

data.name: SignatureWarningRunAnywayHelp
data.value: Nur für diesen Start mit dieser App fortfahren. Windows fordert möglicherweise weiterhin Adminberechtigungen an. Diese Auswahl speichert das Vertrauen für zukünftige Starts nicht.
data.comment: Screen reader help for "Run anyway". This is one-time consent, not a permanent allowlist or a bypass of Windows User Account Control.

data.name: SignatureWarningUnsigned
data.value: Diese App verfügt nicht über eine digitale Signatur.
data.comment: Reason shown only after checking both embedded signatures and installed catalogs. "Signature" means a software digital signature, not a handwritten signature.

data.name: SignatureWarningInvalid
data.value: Die digitale Signatur dieser App stimmt nicht mit dem Inhalt überein. Die Datei wurde möglicherweise geändert, seit sie signiert wurde.
data.comment: Reason for a cryptographic integrity mismatch. Do not translate this as an untrusted publisher or as proof of malware.

data.name: SignatureWarningCertificate
data.value: Das zum Signieren dieser App verwendete Zertifikat konnte gemäß der konfigurierten Vertrauensrichtlinie nicht überprüft werden.
data.comment: Reason for a certificate-chain or trust-policy failure. A certificate is a digital code-signing certificate. Do not imply the application is necessarily malicious.

data.name: SignatureWarningRevoked
data.value: Ein Zertifikat, mit dem die Signatur dieser App überprüft wurde, wurde widerrufen.
data.comment: Reason when Windows reports certificate revocation. Distinct from unavailable revocation information and certificate expiration.

data.name: SignatureWarningDistrusted
data.value: Die Signatur oder das Signaturzertifikat dieser App wurde ausdrücklich als nicht vertrauenswürdig eingestuft.
data.comment: Reason for an explicit Windows trust-policy denial, not merely an unknown certificate or missing verification information.

data.name: SignatureWarningExpired
data.value: Diese Signatur konnte nicht überprüft werden, weil ein erforderliches Zertifikat abgelaufen ist.
data.comment: Reason for a certificate expiration that prevents signature validation. Do not imply every app with a currently expired signing certificate fails; a valid timestamp can allow it.

data.name: SignatureWarningRevocationUnavailable
data.value: Informationen zur Zertifikatssperrung sind im Windows-Cache nicht verfügbar. PowerToys konnte die Signaturüberprüfung nicht abschließen.
data.comment: Verification uses cached certificate revocation information on this computer, not a guaranteed online check. Unavailable cache data is inconclusive; it is not evidence that the certificate was revoked or that the app is safe.

data.name: SignatureWarningUnresolvedTarget
data.value: Die ausführbare Datei konnte nicht gefunden oder überprüft werden.
data.comment: Reason when the executable file to be launched could not be resolved for signature verification.

data.name: SignatureWarningUnavailable
data.value: Die Signaturüberprüfung konnte nicht abgeschlossen werden.
data.comment: Generic inconclusive verification result. Do not translate as a confirmed invalid signature, revocation, or malicious application.
